metadata.title: TestEnvironment
metadata.description: Seeds a realistic identity test environment in Entra ID, Active Directory, Okta, Authentik, FreeIPA, PingOne or OneLogin - users in every lifecycle state, groups, devices and hosts, and the access policy over them - and tears it down again cleanly, proving ownership of every object before deleting it. One connect-seed-report-teardown surface for all seven, no module dependencies, Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7.
